title: Mosaic batcher proposer: workload profiling + safe continuous batching parameters
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Build a production-ready 'proposer' service that takes historical workload traces and live telemetry to recommend continuous batching parameters and cache policies per-workload cluster, with safe apply and automated rollback. The proposer must: 1) profile workloads into stable fingerprints, 2) compute recommended parameter vectors (max_batch_ms, target_utilization, kv_cache_prefetch_threshold, batch_timeout_alpha), 3) simulate cost/latency tradeoffs offline, 4) produce canary rollout artifacts with guardrails and rollback triggers, and 5) emit human-readable rationale and a differential cost estimate. This ticket covers design, prototype, simulation harness, and a first canary rollout for non-critical internal model routes.
acceptance_criteria: Proposer can ingest 14 days of request traces and output clustered workload profiles with metadata (sequence length histogram, prefix share, KV hit proxy, interarrival distribution)
For each cluster, proposer emits a parameter vector and a simulated cost/latency delta vs baseline with Monte Carlo replay (95% CI)
Canary deploy pipeline: 1% -> 10% -> 50% with automatic pause/rollback on SLO regressions and error-rate increase
Integration tests that fail the rollout when p99 latency increases >15% relative to target for 5 continuous minutes or error rate >0.5%
Operator UI artifact (console link) shows recommended change, expected savings, simulation traces, and a one-click apply/cancel
A post-rollout audit log entry is written for every parameter change including config diff and profiling snapshot
comments: 2026-01-22 — Asha: Initial spike complete. Collected anonymized traces for 3 high-volume routes (chat-short, chat-long, embeddings-bulk). Extracted sequence-length histograms and basic prefix similarity metrics.

2026-02-03 — Liam: Prototype clustering using MinHash + hierarchical agglomerative clustering produced 7 stable clusters for chat-short (silhouette 0.62). Added interarrival time quantiles and token-per-request histograms to feature set.
2026-02-10 — PM review (Nora Chen): Requested explicit cost model mapping tokens->GPU-ms and inclusion of quantization-induced latency correction factors. Added to simulation step.

2026-02-18 — Eng feedback (Marta Iqbal): Safety heuristics proposed: require simulated median latency <= baseline median + 5ms AND simulated p99 <= baseline p99 + 8% before recommending aggressive batching. Also require <75% GPU memory utilization headroom.

2026-02-28 — Security: Confirmed no raw request body will be exported; proposer uses hashed request fingerprints. Security requested audit log schema; engineering added write path to internal audit topic.

2026-03-04 — Simulation results: For chat-short cluster #2, recommended target_utilization=0.78, max_batch_ms=30, batch_timeout_alpha=0.12, predicted cost savings 9% (95% CI 6%–11%) with p99 delta +3ms. Marking this cluster as candidate for canary.
2026-03-06 — Ops (Santiago): Created canary pipeline with rollout percentages and SLO gates in CI. Need to add automatic rollback hook to the router when SLO is breached for 5m.

2026-03-09 — QA: Added deterministic replay test that replays a day's production trace against the runtime with proposed params. Found a regression in embeddings-bulk where kv_cache_prefetch_threshold caused small memory pressure spikes — lowered threshold and re-simulated.

2026-03-10 — Liam: Preparing PR for runtime to accept parameter vectors and expose metrics: proposer.recommendation.applied, proposer.rollback.reason, proposer.simulation.ci_lower, proposer.simulation.ci_upper. Next: run 1% canary on staging this week.
